mission: Wonder exists to discover what becomes visible when intelligibility itself becomes the subject of sustained attention.

Its purpose is to investigate the fifty-four forms of completed intelligibility through their canonical definitions, triaxial identities, X–Y traversals, ordinary examples, unexpected correspondences and neighbouring distinctions.
Wonder is a living study, not a finished explanation.
Its method is inseparable from its subject: What changed? What made that change sufficient? How does the achievement remain available?
Its goal is to become increasingly capable of recognising intelligibility in its own right, and to make that recognition available to others.
discipline: The 54 are forms of completed intelligibility, not 54 kinds of meaning. Recognise the Operative Centre before identifying coordinates. Dimensional Conjunction mutually determines one completion-event; its three dimensions must not be read as additive properties. Historical X–Y traversals are kept alongside, not substituted for, later triaxial resolutions.

definitions.name: Transformation Pattern
definitions.definition: Specifies what kind of unresolvedness is altered between the opening and completed situation.

definitions.name: Completion Topology
definitions.definition: Specifies the structural shape by which the transformation counts as complete.

definitions.name: Persistence Mode
definitions.definition: Specifies how the achieved completion remains available for subsequent uptake.

definitions.name: Differentiation
definitions.definition: A difference that was unavailable, flattened, conflated, or non-operative becomes determinate enough to matter.

definitions.name: Opening
definitions.definition: Availability, reach, continuation, access, or possibility becomes greater than it was under the opening constraint.

definitions.name: Relating
definitions.definition: A bearing, dependency, correspondence, ordering, reciprocity, or mutual determination becomes constitutive of the situation.

definitions.name: Repair
definitions.definition: An organization that fails relative to an operative criterion is changed so that the misfit or fault no longer governs the result.

definitions.name: Integration
definitions.definition: Separate parts acquire determinate roles through organization into a whole and thereby gain structure, mutual support, or joint capacity.

definitions.name: Settlement
definitions.definition: A live demand for further uptake, choice, explanation, completion, adjudication, or continuation is discharged.

definitions.name: Focal
definitions.definition: The transformation becomes complete because completion gathers around one privileged locus. That locus is constitutive of why the transformation counts as complete.

definitions.name: Distributed
definitions.definition: The transformation becomes complete only across a constitutive plurality, span, sequence, range, reciprocal field, set of cases, or system. No single locus is sufficient by itself.

definitions.name: Release
definitions.definition: The transformation becomes complete because something that previously governed the situation loses its determining force. Release means de-governance, not merely removal, absence, negation, separation, physical movement away, or negative wording.

definitions.name: Standing
definitions.definition: The achieved determination itself remains available as the completed result.

definitions.name: Bearing
definitions.definition: The achieved result remains what it is only through a constitutive relation, dependency, contrast, condition, source, proportion, frame, support, or mutual determination.

definitions.name: Efficacy
definitions.definition: The achieved result remains as an accomplished capacity, operative effect, changed continuation, rule, function, or consequential difference in what can happen.

cells.name: Focal mark
cells.xy: X is simply placed as Y.
cells.character: An unresolved particular becomes distinctly available as what it is. The completion resides in the identified particular, rather than in its comparative standing or the response it elicits.

cells.name: Binary bearing
cells.xy: X is classified as one of Y₁ / Y₂.
cells.character: A particular becomes distinctly exceptional, prominent, or otherwise set apart through a constitutive contrast. Its achieved distinctness is its situated standing, not simply its independently identified identity.

cells.name: Boundary act
cells.xy: X is separated from Y by a boundary.
cells.character: A decisive difference becomes an operative discriminator. Completion consists in the distinction determining which continuation occurs at a privileged threshold or decision point.

cells.name: Scope standing
cells.xy: X is constrained to the specific Y.
cells.character: A previously conflated range becomes an articulated pattern of differences. The achieved result is the determinate differentiation of the relevant field, not an isolated identified member.

cells.name: Context-bound mark
cells.xy: X indicates absent Y.
cells.character: A field becomes differentiated through the contextual standings of its members. What distinguishes a member is constituted by the company, scale, or environment in which it stands.

cells.name: Field separation
cells.xy: X differs from Y only within scope S.
cells.character: A range of relevant differences becomes a differentiated practice of response. Its completion is an achieved discrimination across cases that can no longer be handled interchangeably.

cells.name: Opposed standing
cells.xy: X stands against Y.
cells.character: A definite difference becomes available when an imposed sameness or categorisation ceases to determine what can be distinguished. The achieved distinction stands beyond the formerly governing conflation.

cells.name: Graded contrast
cells.xy: X varies toward Y along a continuum.
cells.character: Difference becomes determinate through comparison after a privileged norm ceases to dictate its interpretation. The achieved distinction is comparative without one term having to count as the standard from which the others deviate.

cells.name: Exclusive cut
cells.xy: X selects only one among Y options.
cells.character: An inherited conflation loses authority over response, allowing relevant differences to govern selection or exclusion. The completion is discrimination freed from a classification that previously overrode it.

cells.name: Source field
cells.xy: X expands outward into Y.
cells.character: A definite avenue of access becomes available at the point that governs entry. The achieved opening is an established entrance into what had been inaccessible.

cells.name: Source-carried divergence
cells.xy: X moves away from source Y along shifting paths.
cells.character: Access becomes definite through an indispensable enabling connection at its point of entry. The opening remains constituted by that connection, as admission through a key, source, support, or qualifying link.

cells.name: Branching output
cells.xy: X branches into multiple Y’s.
cells.character: A decisive bottleneck becomes passable in practice. The opening is accomplished as the capacity to get through where continuation previously failed.

cells.name: Alternate passage
cells.xy: X reaches Y by different path Z.
cells.character: A restricted repertoire becomes a definite range of available alternatives or passages. The completion is the expanded field of options itself.

cells.name: Span-carried reach
cells.xy: X affects distant Y.
cells.character: A field of possibilities becomes available through a determinate pattern of enabling conditions. The achieved latitude is differentiated by what supports access across that field.

cells.name: Field distribution
cells.xy: X is spread as field Y.
cells.character: Feasible continuation expands across a span whose intervening points must support passage. The completion is extended reach accomplished through the relevant course.

cells.name: Released option
cells.xy: X can follow any Y₁, Y₂, Y₃…
cells.character: A possibility becomes definitely available because a former veto ceases to determine its availability. The result is an established option that the old restriction no longer closes.

cells.name: Continual passage
cells.xy: X gradually transitions into Y.
cells.character: Availability becomes grounded in a support that renders a formerly governing restriction non-determining. The opening is independent of that restriction but remains constituted through its positive enabling basis.

cells.name: Edge opening
cells.xy: X grows at its edges into Y.
cells.character: Continuation becomes executable beyond a constraint that formerly determined its stopping point. The achievement is an operative freedom to proceed where that constraint no longer controls what can happen.

cells.name: Direct bearing
cells.xy: X relates directly to Y.
cells.character: A bearing becomes definite through a decisive point of connection or reference. The achieved intelligibility is an established attachment: this belongs with, points to, follows from, or bears upon that.

cells.name: Pivoted balance
cells.xy: X balances with Y around pivot Z.
cells.character: Something acquires a definite position, weight, or significance through a constitutive reference point. Its determination resides in its bearing upon that reference, rather than being detachable from it.

cells.name: Responsive return
cells.xy: X mirrors Y.
cells.character: A bearing is consummated in a definite response. Something reaches a responsive locus and is taken up there in a way that constitutes what happens.

cells.name: Sequential link
cells.xy: X leads sequentially to Y.
cells.character: A plurality becomes determinate as an articulated arrangement of bearings. The completion is the established configuration: how its terms connect, follow, correspond, or stand in order.

cells.name: Reciprocal shift
cells.xy: X changes in response to Y.
cells.character: Terms become determinate through what they are to one another. Their relevant identities, positions, proportions, or significance belong to a constitutive field of bearings.

cells.name: Relational cycle
cells.xy: X returns to Y in a loop.
cells.character: A field of bearings closes into an operative course: effects pass through its connections and return, propagate, or coordinate in a way that determines continuation.

cells.name: Pattern alignment
cells.xy: X aligns structurally with Y.
cells.character: An arrangement becomes determinate independently of variations that previously governed whether it counted as the same arrangement. The completion is relational invariance: a structure stands despite changes in its presentation or carriers.

cells.name: Role correspondence
cells.xy: X shares deep pattern with Y.
cells.character: A correspondence becomes determinate through a constitutive role once particular embodiment ceases to govern what can occupy that role. Different things can stand for, replace, or answer to one another because of their bearing within a situation.

cells.name: Emergent coordination
cells.xy: X interacts locally to produce global Y.
cells.character: A relational influence becomes operative by overcoming a previously governing separation or independence. What emerges is a course of coordination that cannot be supplied by the terms’ isolated continuations.

cells.name: Focal adjustment
cells.xy: X shifts slightly toward Y.
cells.character: A fault is resolved in a decisive corrected determination. The achievement is the sound version at the point whose misfit had governed the result.

cells.name: Proportional correction
cells.xy: X rebalances Y’s influence.
cells.character: A local misfit becomes a proper fit through the counterpart, proportion, or requirement that constitutes its adequacy. The corrected reality is an achieved match, not a freestanding improved item.

cells.name: Load transfer
cells.xy: X transfers strain to Y.
cells.character: Failure at a decisive functional locus is resolved as restored operation. The achievement consists in that locus properly doing what its failure had prevented.

cells.name: Cross-position validation
cells.xy: X is tested by flipping into Y (its opposite).
cells.character: A faulty account or arrangement becomes sound across its implicated range. The completion is a corrected configuration whose validity survives the necessary cross-checks rather than a succession of locally improved fragments.

cells.name: Joint-bound repair
cells.xy: X is corrected by its dual Y.
cells.character: Misfitting parts acquire a proper pattern of mutual fit. The corrected reality is their alignment through the interfaces that constitute adequacy across the arrangement.

cells.name: In-course correction
cells.xy: X changes direction toward Y.
cells.character: An interrupted or faulty course becomes properly executable across its essential stages. Repair is accomplished as restored operation through the process, rather than as a sound diagram of it.

cells.name: Limit reset
cells.xy: X redefines its limits as Y.
cells.character: A governing error loses its power to organise the result, allowing a sound determination to stand. Repair is complete as the corrected basis or limit, rather than as endless compensation within the erroneous arrangement.

cells.name: Condition reversal
cells.xy: X is resolved by reversing into Y.
cells.character: Adequacy is restored through the actual requirement after a misleading rule or assumed necessity loses governance. The repaired reality is a fit whose positive criterion displaces the basis of the former misfit.

cells.name: Disorder released
cells.xy: X returns from disorder into Y.
cells.character: Proper functioning becomes independent of the fault and the compensations it had forced. The achievement is operation whose course the former disorder no longer dictates.

cells.name: Focal whole
cells.xy: X and Y form a functional unit.
cells.character: Separate elements acquire determinate membership and roles as one organisation gathered around a constitutive centre. The achieved reality is that centred whole, not simply a collection with a prominent member.

cells.name: Frame-held whole
cells.xy: X and Y collapse into one interpretive frame.
cells.character: Parts acquire unity through their indispensable common bearing upon a frame, anchor, or support. What is achieved is a held whole: its coherence is constituted through that focal bearing.

cells.name: Joint capacity
cells.xy: X and Y interlock to form system Z.
cells.character: Separate contributions acquire a joint capacity through a coordinating centre. Integration is accomplished as the centred whole’s ability to act, rather than as its arrangement alone.

cells.name: Role array
cells.xy: X aligns within structural matrix Y.
cells.character: Parts acquire a determinate organisation as the roles of an articulated whole. The achievement is the whole’s differentiated composition, established across its structure.

cells.name: Mutual-support structure
cells.xy: X and Y support one another’s constraints.
cells.character: Parts become one coherent organisation through their sustaining bearings upon one another. The whole exists as an interdependent structure, rather than as a collection whose unity can be supplied externally.

cells.name: Role activation
cells.xy: X fills its role within system Y.
cells.character: Complementary roles acquire the capacity for joint performance across an organisation. The achieved integration is coordinated competence, not merely agreed membership or mutual dependence.

cells.name: Self-maintaining equilibrium
cells.xy: X meets equalizing forces from Y.
cells.character: A determinate whole takes shape when divisions that formerly dictated separation cease to govern its organisation. The achievement is an established unity beyond that fragmenting basis.

cells.name: Sustained equilibrium
cells.xy: X and Y oscillate into stability.
cells.character: Unity becomes constituted through actual sustaining bonds after inherited divisions cease to determine belonging. The whole remains a held coherence, but the old separations no longer decide its membership.

cells.name: Convergent whole
cells.xy: X approaches final Y regardless of origin.
cells.character: Fragmented contributions become one executable undertaking when separate claims to control cease to dictate their organisation. The completion is joint action whose unity the former divisions cannot fragment.

cells.name: Settled alternative
cells.xy: X is affirmed as Y with no alternatives.
cells.character: A live demand converges on a definite answer or choice that discharges it. The achieved reality is the determination that settles this matter at its decisive point.

cells.name: Unified settlement
cells.xy: X becomes indistinguishable from Y.
cells.character: A particular matter becomes settled through the terms, commitment, or condition that constitutes closure. Its achieved status is settlement-under-that-bearing rather than an unconditional answer.

cells.name: Path completion
cells.xy: X arrives at final Y.
cells.character: An unresolved demand is discharged in a decisive arrival, instruction, or action that determines continuation. Settlement is accomplished as the end of the need to seek or choose at that locus.

cells.name: Recurrence settlement
cells.xy: X regularly leads to Y.
cells.character: A plurality of outstanding demands is discharged in a complete answering account or resolved course. Closure belongs to the relevant range and its interconnections, rather than to one terminal answer.

cells.name: Condition-bound settlement
cells.xy: X always implies Y under valid conditions.
cells.character: A field of claims becomes settled through the conditions and recognitions that constitute closure across it. The achieved settlement is a supported pattern of closure, not merely a list of final answers.

cells.name: Case settlement
cells.xy: X typically produces Y across cases.
cells.character: Unresolved demands across an undertaking are discharged as an executable course of continuation. The achievement is a settled practice or procedure that does not leave the requisite next moves undecided.

cells.name: Transformation release
cells.xy: X remains Y under all transformations.
cells.character: Definite closure becomes available when a remainder ceases to require further adjudication. What persists is the settled determination, despite objections, variation, or incompleteness that no longer governs whether the matter must remain open.

cells.name: Retrospective settlement
cells.xy: X reinterprets earlier states as Y.
cells.character: A demand for further explanation, accounting, or redress loses force through a constitutive reconnection. Closure exists through the bearing that makes the remaining material intelligible or the former claim discharged.

cells.name: Continuation discharge
cells.xy: X settles completely into Y.
cells.character: Continuation becomes free of a demand that had required return, repetition, or further uptake. Settlement is accomplished as the ability to proceed without that unfinished matter governing the next move.

investigations.title: Reciprocal shift: recognising correspondence before naming it
investigations.status: First investigation; proposed examples and distinctions are open to further testing
investigations.source: Original X–Y traversal and cell characterisation in THE_54_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_TABLE.md; canonical identity in THE_54_CONTROL.md; two opening examples in the curator’s commission.
investigations.xy: X changes in response to Y.
investigations.candidate: As X varies, so Y varies.
investigations.insight: The promising invariant is a determination held through the correspondence of variation. The terms are intelligible in relation to one another across a field; their bearing is not an extra comment attached after each has been understood independently. The proposed ‘as … so’ expression can make this visible, but it may also describe one-way covariance. It is therefore a recognition aid, not a replacement for the original traversal or a proof of strict two-way causation.

threeQuestions.a: Two varying terms that might have been noticed separately become intelligibly connected as corresponding variations.
A determinate, contextually justified pattern of bearing across the relevant cases—not the mere repetition of the word ‘as’.

threeQuestions.q: How does the achievement remain available?
threeQuestions.a: Through the relation constituting how the terms count, vary or are positioned in that field.

examples.sentence: As the temperature increased, the pressure increased.
examples.note: Promising when the fixed-volume conditions and observed relation are supplied; the sentence alone cannot establish its physical basis.

examples.sentence: The longer the day went on, the more my feet hurt.
examples.note: A lived progression and the changing felt burden can be recognised in correspondence without sharing the physics sentence’s meaning.

examples.sentence: The longer the onions cooked, the sweeter they tasted.
examples.note: An ordinary graded dependency; test whether the cooking circumstances make the bearing determinate.

examples.sentence: As the drummer quickened the beat, the dancers quickened their steps.
examples.note: Tempo and movement stand in correspondence, though the example may also be read as a one-way response; a useful boundary test.

examples.sentence: As the soil dried, the leaves drooped.
examples.note: A possible observed dependence; other causes must be considered before assigning the governing achievement.

neighbors.name: Sequential link · Relating × Distributed × Standing
neighbors.contrast: ‘First the bell rang; then the room emptied’ establishes an ordered arrangement. Sequence alone does not make the positions constitutively varying together.

neighbors.name: Relational cycle · Relating × Distributed × Efficacy
neighbors.contrast: ‘The thermostat sensed the heat and switched the heater off; cooling eventually switched it on again’ presents operative feedback and continuation, not just a held correspondence.

neighbors.name: Pivoted balance · Relating × Focal × Bearing
neighbors.contrast: ‘The seesaw balanced around its fulcrum’ makes a privileged pivot constitutive; Cell 23 requires a distributed field rather than one decisive locus.

neighbors.name: Pattern alignment · Relating × Release × Standing
neighbors.contrast: ‘These two charts preserve the same arrangement even after the labels change’ stresses invariance despite a once-governing presentation difference, not a co-varying bearing.

investigations.pedagogy: Begin with the temperature/pressure and feet/day sentences without a cell name. Ask learners what was achieved in each, and then what persists across their different meanings. Introduce ‘As … so’ only after they notice correspondence; next reveal the original X–Y traversal and Relating × Distributed × Bearing, then compare with 22 and 24. A useful diagnostic is whether the learner can explain why ‘First X, then Y’ and ‘X drives a feedback loop’ are not automatically the same achievement. This is a proposal for a teaching test, not an observed learner outcome.
openQuestions: Does ‘As X varies, so Y varies’ reliably reveal Bearing, or does it sometimes reduce the cell to covariance?
When is an apparent variation correspondence only an incidental sequence or a shared external cause?
What examples expose the boundary between a constitutive distributed bearing and an operative feedback cycle?
